spec: spme.bspline, spme.bspline_and_deriv, spme.spline_weights, spme.euler_spline_factor, spme.influence_at, spme.assign, spme.assign_squared_charges, spme.forces (bit for bit); spme.kspace (within a tolerance)
generator: lake exe spec-vectors (NewenSpec.SPME, the *Float functions; SplitMix64, fixed seed)
encoding: every float is the hex string of its IEEE 754 binary64 bits; counts, orders, nshape and integer coordinates are floats; a vector is x, y, z; a symmetric tensor xx, xy, xz, yy, yz, zz; a box is rectangular, a, b, c; grids in storage order z + Nz (y + Ny x)
layout_bspline: n, u, bspline(n, u), bspline_and_deriv(n, u)
layout_spline_weights: n, u, n weights, n derivatives
layout_influence_at: case (nx, ny, nz, n, nshape, width, box), l, ghat, gammahat (reciprocal basis from reciprocal_box of the box)
layout_influence_function: case; ghat per point, gammahat per point
layout_assign: nx, ny, nz, n, box, n_atoms, per atom r, q; grid
layout_forces: nx, ny, nz, n, box, atoms, eps0_inv, convolution grid; per atom force
layout_spme_energy: case (grid 8^3), eps0_inv, atoms; k-space energy through dftFloat
